column3: GetDifficulty: bare read of the game's +0x254, no check; prose at fn_get_difficulty

EndGame/2: FIXED -- empties the end message (0x0082e7ec) for any player, then slot 0x48 (0x00524090): a win marks the team (0x00522e20) won and the rest of the first eight lost; a loss marks only slots below 8 and declares the first eight's last side won (0x005651e0, allied flag + enemy mask); test match_end_game_follows_the_game_objects_slot_0x48. End screens and teardown are display
EndGame/3: message kept only for the local (human) player, before the rule; then 0x00524090 as EndGame/2
GetTime: game +0x1258, the millisecond the scripts' wheel stands at = the scheduler's now
MapSize: [map+0xbc], the inclusive right edge = extent - 1

GetTeamOverallScore: FIXED -- team is 0x00522e20's (allied flag both sides, first eight, no participation test) and gold_used/500 (0x0056c9a5), signed power*rating/100; test match_team_overall_score_is_the_military_team_over_a_different_term. power_score cache (+0x290 gate) not reproduced, as before
GetTeamMilitaryScore: FIXED -- team is 0x00522e20's (allied flag both sides), unsigned average 0x0056c640; test match_team_military_score_averages_over_mutual_allies_in_the_first_eight

EvalGroup: FIXED -- group map lookup 0x004c93c0 (miss 0), the group query's live members only (templates excluded), unit bit, object_power low 16 bits summed; test match_eval_group_sums_the_power_of_the_groups_units
MapName: pushes the game's string at +0x198 ('Current map'); its writer not traced, engine answers map.xml's name; one display-only site

GetVecByDir: FIXED -- 32-bit sum of squares (unsigned to the table root 0x0067c3d0) and 32-bit imul/idiv per component, both wrapping; zero length answers (0,0); test heading_vec_by_dir_wraps_where_the_executable_does
GetDirByAngle: (trunc(100 cos(d*3.1415/180)), trunc(100 sin(..))) via _ftol; table spans [-360,720] (corpus -45..585), outside it reduced mod 360 where the x87 is fed the raw angle (labelled)
OnLeft: b.x*a.y - b.y*a.x > 0 in wrapping 32-bit arithmetic
GetAngleByDir: 32-bit sum of squares, sqrt < 0.0001 answers 0, asin(|y|/len) unfolded per quadrant with 3.1415, truncated; the double-rounding residue of a whole degree labelled
GetVec: to - from (32-bit), then GetVecByDir arithmetic; coincident points divide by zero in the original, (0,0) here

ExploreArea: name, then player; group dictionary 0x004c93c0, a miss or dead front member prints and explores nothing; player outside 0..15 nothing; stamp at the area's centre (0x004d67a0) with radius box bottom - centre y (FIXED, 0x004c95c1: was a covering circle) and the player's viewflags (FIXED: share-view slots too); test fog_explore_area_stamps_a_rectangles_half_height_not_a_covering_circle. A rectangle authored bottom-up (negative radius in the original) is sorted here; no shipped area is
ExploreAll: 0x005157c0 fills every half-word 0xFFFF and empties the eight slots' fine records; its +0xf0 flag and the redraw rect (0x006499d0) are display, no reader among the map's own methods

IsExplored: player then point; no manager answers false; 0x00515950 with player-1 unsigned, so player 0 and slots past 7 answer true (FIXED), a partial cell answers its 32-unit fine record (0x00514a60, FIXED); tests fog_is_explored_takes_a_one_based_player, fog_explore_circle_is_the_stamp_full_inside_a_rim_around_and_nothing_beyond

ExploreCircle: radius, point, player; player outside 0..15 nothing; 0x00516450 returns for radius 0 or empty mask (FIXED), stamps the viewflags mask (FIXED, SetRelation 0x005652f0 share-view); test fog_a_players_stamps_reach_every_slot_it_shares_its_view_with. Player 0 reads before the record array in the original (fault), nothing here

Unit::GetUnexploredPoint: FIXED -- invalid receiver (-1,-1); radius < sight or > 800,000 -> max(sight*4, 512), capped 3,000; offsets -r/2..r/2 by 300, x outer, clamped to the map; unexplored for the owner slot, obstruction cell clear, terrain 12/13 iff water_unit; first 100; one Range(0, n-1) draw; test fog_get_unexplored_point_samples_a_300_unit_grid_and_draws_one_candidate

TimeToAnimFinish: end = start + declared duration (FIXED: was the frame strip; [anim+0x4c] via 0x0053e6c0/0x0053cef0), 0 when nothing plays (FIXED: a state's loop and a finished animation are slot -1, 0x0053e860/0x0053f6a0); tests anim_scripts_see_the_declared_duration_not_the_frame_strip, anim_a_states_loop_and_a_finished_animation_are_not_playing. Gaps: a strip shorter than its declared length stops counting at the strip's end; no transition animation's time in front (no transitions in this engine)

StartAnim: handle, own position -> no turn, slot-1 into the array, 0x0053e6c0; an object off the map starts nothing (FIXED, test anim_an_object_off_the_map_plays_nothing). Gaps: [obj+0x130] script action mode reset and the action-finished handler called when idle (0x005b0f70: a dead unit's death animation first) not modelled; no transition animations
TimeToActionMoment: start + action_time*duration/duration (= action_time), 0 when nothing plays (FIXED as TimeToAnimFinish). Gap: no transition animation's time in front

Flying::PlayAnim: Z -1..1024, then the slot (FIXED: checked before the flight state is written, bad slot returns without suspending), point clamped into the map (FIXED, 0x00422b70), flight state, StopAnimation, 0x0053e6c0, wait = declared duration (FIXED, 0x0051bcba); re-entry returns; test anim_flying_play_anim_refuses_a_bad_slot_before_it_moves_and_clamps_its_point. Design: no animation origin, the bird arrives at the call rather than at the next StopAnimation (documented phase)

Obj::PlayAnim: handle (dead: no suspend), own position -> no turn, mode 6, arms the animation timer only when none is pending, suspends until 0x005b0f70 mode 6 runs 0x005a76c0 twice (start, then wake at the end). Engine starts now and suspends for the declared duration (FIXED: was the strip). Design gaps: an animation already playing is interrupted here, waited out there; an object off the map never wakes there, suspends 0 here

Obj::SetState: handle (dead: reports, pushes an int -- stack leak not reproduced), CObj::SetState(n-1, no transition) 0x0053e860: resting in the state already returns (FIXED), else slot -1 and the state word; test anim_set_state_dispatches_on_the_handle_type

Squad::SetState/1: handle word split (player low 4, index), 0x00443e30, state as 16 bits at +0x28 and the game's running time at +0x2c (FIXED: was the world's turn-end time); no null check, no SF_NOAI test; test anim_squad_set_state_stamps_the_scripts_millisecond. State kept 32 bits wide as every writer keeps it
Squad::SetState/3: state, flags (flags|set)&~clr, time, null-checked; not bound -- both corpus sites (SQUADMONITOR.VS:337/339) are inside a comment
GetAnim: handle (dead 0), [obj+0x50] < 0 -> 0 else slot+1 (FIXED: a state's loop and a finished animation answer 0); test anim_a_states_loop_and_a_finished_animation_are_not_playing

IsInState: no pending message 27 (the animation timer) on [obj+0xc] (0x0053cfc0 -> 0x00687820); here !animating. Approximated: the timer lapses at the declared duration, the strip's end here; a dead receiver faults there, false here

Unit::GetAnimDuration: no receiver check (faults on a dead handle; 0 here), [anim[n]+0x4c] -- the declared duration (FIXED: was the strip); test anim_scripts_see_the_declared_duration_not_the_frame_strip
GetAnimTime: handle (dead 0), entity's anim[n-1], null 0, else [anim+0x4c] the declared duration (FIXED); test as GetAnimDuration's

StartDelayedAnim: as StartAnim with the delay as StartAnimation's start offset. The one shipped delay (-1) applies at once and arms no timer, so in the original the animation never ends (IsInState stays true, TimeToAnimFinish counts to start-1+duration); here it is StartAnim. A positive delay is not deferred (no per-object timer); no shipped site
ClearSelection: player-1 record vs the local one at [globals+0x12c8] (out-of-range numbers name no record), then 0x005e7e50 empties the one selection; no complaint, no other effect

Obj::Select: handle, vtbl+0x50 dead (FIXED: was health<=0, a broken building is selected), local-player guard, then the insert's gates (0x005e7d80): spawn-template bit [obj+0x2c]&0x08000000 (FIXED: was SetNoselectFlag's [obj+0x194]&0x800000; test select_refuses_a_template_and_takes_a_noselect_unit_and_a_broken_building). Gap: vtbl+0x74 visibility to the local player (0x005b1030 units, 0x004dc990 catapult) not reproduced; every shipped site selects its own object, which passes on the owner arm

SquadList::Select: FIXED (was unbound for a SquadList receiver) -- local guard, selection emptied, then unless EOL (0x00420170) every member of every squad from the list's start through the insert; test squadlist_select_empties_the_selection_and_takes_every_member_from_the_start. Same vtbl+0x74 gap; no shipped site
SwapSelectedObj: from by handle, membership (0x005e3930), erase+notify (0x005e7e00), to by handle through the insert (FIXED: a template is refused, test as Select's); same vtbl+0x74 gap on to
_GetSelection: fresh list (0x0041edd0), selection's ids copied front to back (0x0041f290), handed back as a temporary
Obj::Deselect(player): FIXED (was unbound) -- handle, local-player guard, 0x005e7e00; no dead test; test the_uncalled_deselect_and_selection_assigned_forms_follow_their_bodies. No shipped site
Obj::Deselect(): handle only, 0x005e7e00 erases from both lists and runs the changed handler whether or not the object was there
IsSelectionAssigned(player, slot): FIXED (was unbound) -- player 1..16, slot 0..9, that group's size [group+0x1c] (0x005b8760) non-zero; test as Deselect(player)'s. No shipped site
IsSelectionAssigned(player): player 1..16, first non-empty of ten groups at record+0xac stride 0x2c

Obj::ExecDefaultCmd: FIXED -- dead receiver refused (vtbl+0x50) and the order issued as the receiver's owner ([[obj+0x70]+8], not -1), so control is asked and the command is a player's; test exec_default_cmd_on_an_object_is_issued_as_its_owner_and_refuses_the_dead. No shipped site
Obj::_LastSelectionTime: [obj+0x144], -1 for an unresolvable handle; stamped by the changed handler (0x005e7910) for every member of the new selection
ObjList::ExecDefaultCmd: object argument to a handle word (0xffff for none), then 0x004f4ff0(list, pt, handle, replace, modifier, -1); temporary list released
WasSelectionAssigned(player, n): FIXED (was unbound) -- 0x004e5940(player-1, 1<<(n&31) or all bits for n<0, test) on /Player<player>/SelectionAssigned; test as Deselect(player)'s. No shipped site
WasSelectionAssigned(player): 0x004e5940 formats /Player%d/SelectionAssigned with the argument as given (no bounds) and tests any bit
GetTerrainHeight: point clamped into the map rect [world+0xb4..0xc0], then 0x0053eaa0 (0 outside the layer's rect) -> bilinear 0x0053dc00

Flying::z: handle only, invalid answers 0; 0x0051b040: ground -> terrain height at vtbl+0x40, animating in the window -> lerp over [obj+0x64], else z_from. The animation-finished virtual 0x0051b450 (z_from := z_to, or in_air cleared at a landing's end) is not modelled; the clamped clock gives the same z

Flying::PickLandingPoint: flock (0x004fee10, sight-100, own class), ahead tally over every mate (>57%), mates on the ground or landing tried five times (Y-first +/-100 jitter, can_land on the mate 0x0051c210, heading window 0x0051b600), give-up roll between(0,5)!=0 -> (-1,-1), straight ahead with SetLen and Y-first jitter; FIXED: the straight-ahead spot meets can_land on the bird itself (0x0051cae5) and answers (-1,-1) when it fails; test flying_pick_landing_point_refuses_a_straight_ahead_spot_it_cannot_land_on
RandomOffset: two between(-n, n) draws, the first is y
Unit::dir: [obj+0x48]/[obj+0x4c] with no null check (the original faults on an invalid receiver; zero vector here)

Flying::AdjustFlyDir: inside the 800-unit margin leaves the point alone; edge chosen x-high, x-low, y-high; quarter turns, already-away keeps the point, +/-15 degrees by the heading's x, better-of test, turned back; invalid receiver leaves the argument

Flying::PickFlyingPoint: body matches (flock-follow on an animating in_air mate, 30-degree scan scored by 0x0051c2f0 with the 60 cut, SetLen, Y-first +/-n/5 jitter at 0x0051c639). Gap in the state it reads: in_air is not cleared when a landing animation ends (0x0051b450 unmodelled), so the crowding count can include a landed bird

Query::GetAverageDirection: vtbl+0x20 without Refresh -- averages the query's last result; engine re-evaluates. Equal at the one shipped site, whose count() refreshed it on the same line; empty or invalid answers (0, 0)

GetShipToBoard: [unit+0x18c] pushed unresolved; an unresolvable receiver reads through null in the original (no check), invalid here; an id the world no longer holds answers the invalid handle, which is what .IsValid of the stale handle reports

NotifyBoardUnit: argument then receiver, diagnostic and nothing on a miss; 0x005c7e70 finds in the deque, then in the holder, pushes, starts boardunit (0x005c66e0: clear, append, end head) unless the running command is already boardunit (0x005c7f6a), stamps [unit+0x18c]

BestCandidateToBoard: prune (handle or vtbl+0x50), strict nearest isqrt from 900000000, invalid handle for none; gap: 0x005c7b93 compares (unit holder == 0) against the ship's holder handle as a number, which this engine's ids cannot image (fires only for holder handle 0 or 1)

NotifyBoardUnitCancel: FIXED -- 0x005c75c0 acts only on a listed unit not inside the ship's holder, erases it and clears [unit+0x18c] (0x005c76ad); was erase-only and touched aboard units; test boarding_cancel_takes_a_walker_off_the_list_and_clears_its_field. Latch [ship+0x1d8] argued equivalent in the header
NumUnitsToBoard: bare deque size, no prune; 0 for an unresolvable receiver

CancelArmyBoard: 0x0052fd60 -- InShip (0x005319a0) of the hero vs each resolvable member, detach the differing (0x005db190), then for a hero not in a ship the cancel above, which now clears its field; test boarding_cancel_army_board_drops_the_followers_on_the_other_side
AreUnitsToBoard: holder occupancy == capacity empties the deque (0x005c7989) and answers false; else prune (handle or vtbl+0x50) and answer non-empty; false for an unresolvable receiver

BoardUnit: FIXED -- 0x005c7840 enters through 0x005d3e10 unforced, so 0x00532160 refuses a full holder (was: no capacity check); admitted unit stopped and placed as garrison_enter, delisted (0x005c78ef), field kept; test boarding_board_unit_needs_150_units_and_a_berth. Gaps: the entry detaches from an old holder before the room test (unreachable: a held unit's pos is (-1,-1)); the feeder timer 0x1f it cancels is not FeederSystem state

FindPointToStay: FIXED -- free-spot test is 0x0040a990 = MovementSystem::spot_free with the ship's class radius: block under the two radii summed inside a window of radius + ShipBattle's (water) or 40, route locks count (was: blocked from the window, no locks); dy then dx draws, area/passability/spot, 100 tries then pos; test find_point_to_stay_is_the_first_candidate_that_passes_three_tests. Unresolvable receiver faults in the original, (0,0) here, labelled

NotifyShipBoardingCancel: 0x005c76c0 kills the running boardship/boardshiphero/boardshipcommon of each listed member, FIXED: then runs 0x0052fd60 for every hero in the ship's holder (0x005c77bf..0x005c7818), then empties the deque; test boarding_ship_cancel_splits_the_armies_of_the_heroes_aboard

UnboardAllUnits: 0x005c84b0 lattice 0x005c8010, front of the holder's deque each time, 0x005c81d0 ordered-erase draw, 0x005d3f20 exit, until points run out. Gaps: drop order is ascending id here, boarding order there (no per-holder list); 0x005d3f20's feeder search arm for a foodless unit (0x00518b80, a world draw) and AI clock stamp [ai+0x5f8] not reproduced; rate limit, supply refill, door re-route argued unreachable for a ship

UnboardUnits: list then receiver popped, lattice from the ship's pos, list order, points tested before each member, only members in this ship's holder dropped. Gap: 0x005d3f20's feeder search arm and AI clock stamp, as UnboardAllUnits
